name: B10-0430/2026 (PfE) – The need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text:
This is a motion for a resolution from the PfE political group. It is not law. It asks the EU to treat the Muslim Brotherhood as a terrorist organisation, to stop EU money going to groups linked to Islamist networks, to tighten rules on foreign funding of religious groups, and to restrict religious dress and unauthorised mosques. It also asks member states to change migration, asylum and education policies.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of requests and opinions, not binding law.
- **Who it affects:** EU institutions, member states, Muslim organisations and NGOs named in the text.
- **What happens next:** It goes to a plenary vote; if passed, it is sent to the Council, Commission, Europol and AMLA.
